headline: Multi-tenant OAuth requires mandatory Sandbox approval and a 2-3 week marketplace review, but independent security audits are not required.
summary: Developers can immediately use direct API keys for single-tenant internal integrations. To build a multi-tenant OAuth app for external Keka customers, developers must register on the Keka App Portal, request a Sandbox workspace, and undergo a 2-3 week marketplace review. A strict technical requirement during external installation is marking the app status as installed via API within 5 minutes of the initial callback, or Keka will automatically fail the installation.

oauth.pkce: Not enforced; relies on client_secret server-to-server exchange
oauth.redirect_uri_rules: Strict exact match requirement pre-registered in the App Portal
oauth.scopes: kekaapi for token generation, with granular functional scopes like 'Employee And Org Information' managed via API key settings

steps.title: Generate Internal API Keys
steps.detail: If building for a single workspace, a Global Admin can generate API keys directly in Global Settings -> Integrations and Automation -> API Access.

steps.title: Request Sandbox Account
steps.detail: Submit a request for a Sandbox Account via the Keka App Portal to test OAuth 2.0 flows against a demo environment.

steps.title: Wait for Sandbox Activation
steps.detail: Keka team must approve the Sandbox request before development credentials can connect to the test workspace (login.kekademo.com).

steps.title: Implement Authorization Code Flow
steps.detail: Build the OAuth flow. Ensure the backend can exchange the authorization code for an access token within the 5-minute limit.

steps.title: Implement App Installation Callback
steps.detail: Ensure the integration calls Keka's 'Mark App status' endpoint with status '2' (installed) within 5 minutes of receiving the OAuth callback, or the installation is automatically marked as failed.

steps.title: Prepare Setup Documentation
steps.detail: Write comprehensive step-by-step setup documentation explaining how customer admins configure and integrate the app.

steps.title: Submit Listing and App for Review
steps.detail: Submit app details (name, descriptions, screenshots, setup docs) and technical configs on the App Portal.

steps.title: Wait for Partner Review
steps.detail: The Keka partner team reviews the app for security, permissions, and functionality.

steps.title: Live Product Demo
steps.detail: Demonstrate the integration's functionality to the Keka review team upon request.

requirements.text: Sandbox environments must be formally requested and approved prior to standard OAuth development.
The app must call the 'Mark App status' endpoint within 5 minutes of OAuth authorization.
Comprehensive customer-facing setup documentation must be provided in the submission.
Targeting external organizations requires a 2-3 week partner review via the Keka App Portal.

gotchas.text: If your server takes longer than 5 minutes to generate tokens and mark the installation status, Keka fails the install automatically.
Direct API keys are capped at a maximum of 5 active keys per organization.
Rate limits are strictly enforced at 50 requests per minute per integration, returning 429 Too Many Requests if exceeded.
The authorization endpoint validates client credentials properly and redirects to an error page if they are invalid.

permissions.action: Read and write core employee profiles and organizational data
permissions.review_impact: Requires Keka tenant admin consent. Contains sensitive PII which may be subject to stricter evaluation during the marketplace review.

permissions.action: Read and submit time-off and leave applications
permissions.review_impact: Standard admin consent required. Must justify need in App Portal listing.

Access payslips and financial salary structures
permissions.review_impact: Contains highly sensitive financial data; triggers strict review and subject to internal plan restrictions.

blockers.issue: App installations fail immediately after OAuth authorization.
blockers.how_to_proceed: Ensure your backend calls the 'Mark App status' endpoint with a status of 2 within 5 minutes of receiving the callback code.

blockers.issue: API requests consistently return 429 Too Many Requests.
blockers.how_to_proceed: Implement backoff strategies in your AI agent. Keka enforces a strict 50 requests per minute limit that resets every 60 seconds.

agent_can: Implement the OAuth authorization code flow and refresh token logic
Develop the required webhook or API call to the 'Mark App status' endpoint within the 5-minute window
Draft the required customer-facing setup documentation
Draft listing details and descriptions for the marketplace submission
Handle HTTP 429 rate limit backoff logic (50 req/min)
you_must: Register as a developer on the Keka App Portal
Submit the final app for marketplace publication
Attend a live product demo with the Keka partner review team if requested

key_claims.text: OIDC discovery is available and valid on login.keka.com.
The developer portal is live and accessible at developers.keka.com.
Keka app marketplace review typically takes 2-3 weeks.
There are no listing or application fees for publishing an app.
